title: Applebee’s® Introduces NFL Season Wing Ticket: Free Boneless Wings Weekly
summary: PASADENA, Calif., August 31, 2026--Football season is back, and Applebee’s, the Official Grill + Bar Sponsor of the NFL, has one of the hottest tickets in town for fans hunting for gameday food deals. Starting today, guests can sign up for the free Applebee’s NFL Season Wing Ticket, a season-long pass that unlocks six free Boneless Wings To Go every week with a $15 online purchase.
